what_we_could_not_tell_you.claim: No transit or road travel-time data is available in license-clean federal sources; all distances are straight-line upper bounds.
Facility layers cover only federally recognized (CMS POS and HRSA BPHC) sites; free or county-run clinics may be closer than reported.
Respiratory ED visit trends (COVID-19, Influenza, RSV) are reported for the 4-county Atlanta Health Service Area (Clayton, DeKalb, Fulton, Gwinnett), not individual neighborhoods.
PM2.5 air quality in exposure_tracts comes from a 12 km modeling grid interpolated onto census tract IDs (Fulton p90/p10 ratio is 1.05x) and cannot distinguish neighborhoods.
Fulton County has 0 active federal Health Professional Shortage Area (HPSA) geographic designations because all 99 designations are Proposed For Withdrawal.
Disease prevalence figures in CDC PLACES are small-area statistical models (MRP), not patient registries or direct counts, and no 95% confidence intervals are loaded in the snapshot.

who_this_plan_lands_on.finding: The four selected census tracts have a population-weighted Black (Non-Hispanic) share of 81.2% compared to 42.6% across Fulton County overall (+38.6 percentage points), and a Hispanic/Latino share of 8.5% compared to 7.9% countywide.
who_this_plan_lands_on.structural_hypothesis: Although race and ethnicity were completely excluded from the Planner's inputs, uninsured rates, zero-vehicle household rates, and safety-net clinic distance gaps in south and southwest Fulton County strongly co-vary with historical residential segregation and uneven safety-net facility siting.
